agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MAY 22, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting through
 Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors open 30
 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or may
 submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than 4:00
 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the meeting
 and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments, see
 Public Comments/Speakers section.

  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#

  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580

 2939375.2
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of May 8, 2024 City Council Study Session Meeting, May 8, 2024 Regular Session
Meeting, and May 9, 2024 City Council Closed Session Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s subject
matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the presiding
officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written comment, see
Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called to speak while in
the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

2939375.2
 MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 24-001;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2350-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2350-24, determining Planned
  Development Permit No. 24-001 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing an interior
  and exterior remodel and the construction of a new 1,062 sq. ft. addition of habitable
  space to an existing single-family residence located at 32037 Kingspark Court.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2350-24  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 24-001,
  AUTHORIZING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW 1,062 SQ. FT. ADDITION OF HABITABLE
  SPACE AND AN INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR REMODEL OF AN EXISTING 2,516 SQ. FT. TWO-
  STORY SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE LOCATED AT 32037 KINGSPARK COURT

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective May 15, 2024 in the amount of
  $492,643.88

  TREASURERS QUARTERLY REPORT: File and Receive CalPERS Report dated
  March 31, 2024; Stifel Report dated April 9, 2024

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. CONDUCTING THE NOVEMBER 5, 2024 GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  FOR TWO COUNCILMEMBER POSITIONS; RESOLUTION NOS. 2351-24 and
  2352-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2351-24 to call for the holding of a General
  Municipal Election on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, for the election of certain

2939375.2
   officers as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating
  to general law cities; and adopt Resolution No. 2352-24 to request that the Board
  of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles consolidate a General Municipal
  Election to be held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the Statewide General
  Election to be held on that date.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2351-24 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, CALLING FOR THE HOLDING OF A GENERAL
  MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 2024, FOR THE
  ELECTION OF CERTAIN OFFICERS AS REQUIRED BY THE PROVISIONS OF THE LAWS
  OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA RELATING TO GENERAL LAW CITIES

  RESOLUTION NO. 2352-24 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, REQUESTING THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF THE
  COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO CONSOLIDATE A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE
  HELD ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 2024, WITH THE STATEWIDE GENERAL ELECTION TO
  BE HELD ON THE DATE PURSUANT TO SECTION 10403 OF THE ELECTIONS CODE

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  THREE SPRINGS PARK SHADE STRUCTURE PROJECT — APPROVAL OF
  PURCHASE AGREEMENT AWARD, INSTALLATION AGREEMENT AWARD,
  AND CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION – Approve a CEQA Notice of
  Exemption filing for the Shade Structure at Three Springs Park Project; approve a
  Purchase Agreement with Landscape Structures, Inc. in the amount of $21,349.49;
  approve an Installation Agreement with Evergreen Environment, Inc. in the amount
  of $8,500.00; approve project management and inspection fees with Willdan
  Engineering in the amount of $2,500 and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute
  the agreements on behalf of the City.

2.  COMMUNITY PARK PICKLEBALL COURTS PROJECT UPDATE AND
  REQUEST FOR INCREASE IN CONSTRUCTION CONTINGENCY - City Council
  appropriate $83,589 of Community Benefit Fee to the Community Pickleball Courts
  project, authorize the City Manager to approve additional construction change
  orders up to $75,139 for the completion of the project, and approve RRM contract
  Amendment No. 4 to add $8,450 for landscape architectural and civil engineering
  support.

  OR ALTERNATE MOTION

  City Council appropriate $122,589 of Community Benefit Fee to the Community
  Pickleball Courts project, authorize the City Manager to approve additional
  construction change orders up to $114,139 for the completion of the project, and
  approve RRM contract Amendment No. 4 to add $8,450 for landscape architectural
  and civil engineering support.

2939375.2
 NEW BUSINESS:

 1.  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AUDIO VISUAL AND TECHNOLOGY UPGRADES;
  APPROVAL FOR REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL - Approve the Request for Proposal
  for the City Council Chambers Audio Visual and Technology Enhancements.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, May 17, 2024 at 12:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  May 17, 2024
